author: Chris Schommer
title: Brendan Beck tagged early in loss to Twins
desc: Brendan Beck allowed five earned runs on five hits and two walks while striking out three over 3 2/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Twins.
impact: Beck has struggled when called upon to toe the rubber, failing to reach the fourth inning in both of his trips to the mound. The right-hander will likely end up back in Triple-A, posting a 9.45 ERA and 1.80 WHIP with a 0-1 record and 0.80 K/BB ratio across two appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tyler Wells slams door for save in win over Reds
desc: Tyler Wells allowed one hit and one walk over one inning to record the save in Saturday's win over the Reds.
impact: Wells continues a strong stretch of late, holding opponents scoreless in 10 of his last 11 trips to the mound. The right-hander could be in line for increased usage in high-leverage situations while closer Ryan Helsley remains sidelined, posting a 3.02 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with a 1-1 record, 9.3 K/9 ratio, 11 holds, and two saves across 32 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Samuel Basallo goes deep in win over Reds
desc: Samuel Basallo delivered the kind of loud contact that makes you forget the swing-and-miss, going 1-for-4 in a win over the Reds with a home run, three RBI, one run scored and two strikeouts.
impact: Basallo continues a solid stretch at the plate, recording hits in eight of his last 12 contests. The 21-year-old remains one of many streaky bats in the Orioles lineup to this point, slashing .257 with 14 home runs, 42 RBI, and 31 runs scored through 76 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Pete Alonso picks up three hits in win over Reds
desc: Pete Alonso went 3-for-3 in a win over the Reds with a double, one run scored, one RBI, and two walks.
impact: Alonso continues an impactful stretch of late, getting on base in 13 of his last 14 contests. The first baseman continues to flash his explosive power stroke, but remains one of many streaky options in the Orioles lineup, posting an .819 OPS with 19 home runs, 60 RBI, 54 runs scored, and two stolen bases through 90 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Chris Sale picks up ninth win Saturday night
desc: Chris Sale was tagged for three runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out three across five-plus innings in Saturday's 14-3 win over the Mets.
impact: Sale completely shut the Mets down through the first 4 2/3 innings of Saturday's outing. However, he surrendered a solo homer with two outs in the top of the fifth and allowed the next two batters to reach base before getting out of that inning. The ace lefty gave up another homer in the sixth inning and was taken out after a couple more batters reached. Even though he didn't finish off this outing as he would've liked, Sale still recorded his ninth win of the year, as the Braves' bats finally gave him plenty of support. It was Sale's first win since May 20.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jackson Holliday steals base in win over Reds
desc: Jackson Holliday went 0-for-2 in a win over the Reds with two walks, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Holliday has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in six of his last 13 contests. The infielder remains one of the more underwhelming options in the Orioles lineup to this point, hitting .187 with five home runs, 14 RBI, 17 runs scored, and four stolen bases through 38 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Blaze Alexander drives in two in win over Reds
desc: Blaze Alexander went 1-for-4 in a win over the Reds with two RBI, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Alexander continues steady stretch of late, reaching base in eight of his last nine contests. The 27-year-old has been an impactful bat when in the Orioles lineup, batting .302 with three homers, 28 RBI, 25 runs scored, and nine steals through 76 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brandon Young grinds through five in win over Reds
desc: Brandon Young allowed four earned runs on eight hits and three walks while striking out five over five innings in Saturday's win over the Reds.
impact: Young has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more reliable options as part of an inconsistent Orioles rotation, posting a 3.38 ERA and 1.36 WHIP with a 7-2 record and 7.2 K/9 ratio across 14 starts.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jesus Luzardo shuts down Royals on Saturday
desc: Jesus Luzardo gave up just one run on four hits and no walks while striking out nine over six innings in Saturday's 6-1 win against the Royals.
impact: Luzardo was on point Saturday, striking out eight-plus batters for the fourth time in his last five starts and not issuing a single walk for the first time over his last 11 outings. The lefty now ranks fourth in the league with 125 punchouts on the season, and he has dropped his ERA down to 3.75 through 18 starts. Luzardo will be back on the bump Thursday in Cincinnati.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Grant Taylor slams door for save in win over Guardians
desc: Grant Taylor walked one and struck out one over one scoreless inning to earn the save in Saturday's 3-1 win over the Guardians.
impact: Taylor has settled down on the mound of late, holding opponents scoreless in three of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more stable arms as part of a streaky White Sox pitching staff, posting a 2.96 ERA and 1.12 WHIP with a 4-2 record, five holds, and three saves through 34 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colson Montgomery goes deep in win over Guardians
desc: Colson Montgomery went 2-for-5 in a win over the Guardians with a home run, one double, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Montgomery has heated back up at the plate of late, picking up hits in eight of his last 10 contests. The infielder remains one of the more streaky bats in the White Sox lineup to this point, batting .221 with 22 home runs, 51 RBI, 41 runs scored, and one stolen base through 84 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sean Burke cruises on mound in no-decision
desc: Sean Burke allowed one earned run on seven hits while striking out 11 over six innings in Saturday's win over the Guardians.
impact: Burke continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander has provided manager Will Venable with one of the more reliable arms in the White Sox rotation, posting a 3.56 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 9.7 K/9 ratio through 18 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Bryce Eldridge goes deep as Giants edge Rockies
desc: Bryce Eldridge went 2-for-5 in a win over the Rockies with a home run, a double, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Eldridge has caught fire at the plate of late, collecting hits in six of his last seven contests. The 21-year-old offers manager Tony Vitello an explosive bat in an inconsistent Giants lineup, carrying an .852 OPS with seven homers, 19 RBI, and 24 runs scored through 46 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Willy Adames steals base, drives in two in win over Rockies
desc: Willy Adames went 2-for-4 in a win over the Rockies with a double, one run scored, one walk, one stolen base, and two RBI.
impact: Adames has heated up at the plate, recording hits in six of his last eight contests. The shortstop remains one of many inconsistent bats in the Giants lineup to this point, batting .232 with 14 home runs, 34 RBI, 41 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 83 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Luis Arraez racks up three hits in win over Rockies
desc: Luis Arraez went 3-for-5 in a win over the Rockies with a run scored and one RBI.
impact: Arraez continues a torrid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 12 of his last 14 contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the few dynamic bats in an underperforming Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, batting .330 with four home runs, 33 RBI, 45 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 83 games.
